original_query: What is the user experience of the book which penetrated less in schools than in public in 2012 composed of?

summaries.found_via_query: 2012 book that penetrated less in schools than in public settings and its user experience
summaries.summary: A bar chart titled 'eBook Penetration' shows data for School, Public, and Academic sectors from 2010 to 2012. In 2012, the 'School' category (red bars) had lower penetration than 'Public' (also red bars), with School at approximately 40% and Public at 90%. The source is the Library Journal Survey of Ebook Penetration - 2010-2012.
key_facts: The chart displays eBook penetration for School, Public, and Academic sectors from 2010 to 2012.
In 2012, School penetration was around 40%, while Public penetration was around 90%.
The data source is the Library Journal Survey of Ebook Penetration - 2010-2012.
